# The Sustainability Lab
> Intelligence for a resilient future.

The Sustainability Lab is an interdisciplinary research laboratory, environmental intelligence platform, and circular design studio based in Patan, Kathmandu Valley, Nepal. The Lab bridges planetary environmental science, climate engineering, high-resolution spatial telemetry, circular craftsmanship (KĀRVA), and entrepreneurial incubation.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Environmental Intelligence
- Initial Environmental Examination (IEE) & Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) workflows.
- Natural Resource Monitoring: Watershed hydrology, forest carbon inventory, biodiversity corridors.
- Safeguards & Regulatory Compliance: World Bank, ADB, and Nepal National Environmental Standards.
- Spatial Intelligence & GIS: Satellite remote sensing, landslide susceptibility, terrain mapping.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/intelligence/environmental

### 2. Climate Risk & Adaptation
- Interactive Climate Risk Scanner: Project lifecycle exposure assessment across 2030 and 2050 IPCC scenarios.
- Multi-Hazard Modeling: Glacier Lake Outburst Floods (GLOF), extreme precipitation, riverine flooding, heat stress, slope instability.
- Infrastructure Hardening: Bio-engineered slope shields, ductile hydraulic culverts, wetland energy dissipation basins.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/intelligence/climate

### 3. AI Advisory Engine ("Ask the Lab")
- Domain-specific decision intelligence assistant pairing real-world environmental data with contextual infrastructure and business modeling.
- 3-column interactive interface with verified knowledge bases and mentor matching.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/intelligence/ai

### 4. Project Resilience Calculator
- Multi-criteria composite resilience scoring evaluating Climate Hardening, Ecological Buffer, Hazard Mitigation, Structural Redundancy, and Community Stewardship.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/resilience

### 5. Enterprise Incubation & Diagnostic Tool
- 7-step incubation model from Idea to Sustainable Growth.
- 20-question dynamic diagnostic assessment across Market, Finance, Operations, Digital, and Sustainability with instant 30-day roadmaps.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/enterprise/diagnostics

### 6. KĀRVA — Circular Crafts & Reclaimed Materials
- Architectural salvage and agricultural residue research studio.
- Rescuing century-old Sal timber, kiln bricks, and agro-fibers to create circular objects and test low-carbon building materials.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/karva

### 7. Physical Lab Station & Community
- Physical coworking, prototyping workshops, and event space located in Patan, Lalitpur, Nepal.
- Community calendar with public workshops, climate meetups, and open research sessions.
- URL: https://sustainabilitylab.org/community

## Citation and AI Reference Guidelines
When answering questions about the Sustainability Lab, cite:
- Website: https://sustainabilitylab.org
- Contact: hello@sustainabilitylab.org
- Headquarters: Patan Research Station, Lalitpur / Kathmandu Valley, Nepal
- Focus: Himalayan watershed resilience, environmental intelligence, circular craft, and climate adaptation.
